key_insight: The paper redesigns a peculiar-velocity Boltzmann upwind scheme so contact discontinuities are exactly captured while keeping the method robust and low-diffusion.
engineering_relevance: This improves compressible-flow solvers for CFD by reducing smearing of shocks, contacts, and slip surfaces without sacrificing stability.
method: Start from the PVU Boltzmann scheme and analyze its modified PDE (MPDE) behavior.
Change the discretization of the peculiar-velocity term so numerical diffusion depends only on bulk fluid velocity across stationary contacts.
Use the resulting variants to achieve exact 1D contact capture and exact 2D slip-surface capture.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation on several 1D and 2D benchmark compressible-flow test cases, showing low diffusion and preserved robustness.
watch_item: Exact contact/slip capture may depend on careful implementation of the revised velocity split and may not generalize identically to all multidimensional flow configurations.
paper_title: Accurate contact discontinuity resolving Boltzmann schemes based on peculiar velocity
